observations: Source is a pirated/OCR scan (EasyEngineering.net watermark repeated at the bottom of every page as 3 lines: 'Downloaded From: www.EasyEngineering.net' x2 + 'www.EasyEngineering.net' -- strip these). All page numbers in this manifest (frontMatterPages, questionPages, solutionPages) are PDF/chunk-file page numbers matching the '=== PAGE N ===' markers in books-text, NOT the printed page numbers visible in the book's own running headers. PAGE OFFSET RULE: pdf_page = printed_page + 5, confirmed essentially perfectly across the entire 650-page book (verified via running-header page numbers at dozens of points from PDF p.7 to p.649 with zero drift). Front matter = PDF pages 1-5 (cover/disclaimer, title page, publisher info, 2-page table of contents). Paper 1 content starts PDF p.6 = printed p.1. PDF p.650 is a trailing duplicate disclaimer/watermark page, not book content -- book content ends at PDF p.649 (printed p.644), matching the TOC. The TOC's 32 printed-page ranges are perfectly contiguous (each paper's start = previous paper's end + 1), which cross-validates the OCR transcription. SOLUTIONS LOCATION: Disha does NOT use a 'Hints & Solutions' heading anywhere in this book. Each paper is one continuous run of pages: all questions across all sections first (numbered 1..N cumulatively across sections, N is usually 200 for full CWE-style papers, 100 for Prelims-only papers, and variable -- e.g. 155 -- for some Mains papers with a reduced objective count), then solutions restart at '1.' immediately with the answer letter attached, e.g. '1. (c) <explanation>' or compact answer-grid lines like '121. (e) 122. (c) 123. (b)'. Extractors should detect this transition by the numbering reset, NOT by searching for heading text. CAUTION: several question formats (odd-one-out 'N. (a) word (b) word'; cloze/fill-blank option lists; multi-line 'error spotting' questions ending in 'No error') can look identical to a solution line under a naive 'digit + (letter)' pattern match -- a correct detector must confirm the pattern is SUSTAINED (near-continuous) through to the very last page of the paper, not just a local match, since these false-positive formats only cluster briefly (a handful of questions) before textual questions resume. This tripped up 3 of the 32 papers during manifest construction (papers 4, 28, 30) until the detector was hardened; all 32 boundaries in this manifest use the hardened detector, and 8 papers (1, 4, 23, 25, 26, 28, 29, 30) spanning early/late and simple/tricky cases were additionally confirmed by direct manual reads, including all 4 priority SBI-PO-2015+ papers (25, 26, 28, 29). QUALITY: text extraction/OCR is generally clean prose, but math (fractions, roots, inequality symbols like >=, <=) and diagram-based reasoning questions (seating arrangements, family trees, coding-decoding letter/number grids) are frequently garbled into jumbled character sequences or single-letter noise lines -- these are unusable as-is and extractors should expect to reconstruct or flag such questions rather than trust the raw text. All papers are printed as pure objective MCQ (options a-e); no descriptive-answer-era papers were found despite the book spanning back to 2010 -- the pre-2015 'descriptive era' caution did not materialize in this particular book. Most paper title pages are marked 'Based on Memory' (a publisher disclaimer that the paper was reconstructed from candidates' recollections rather than reproduced from an official released paper) -- this is near-universal in this book (30 of 32 chunk-file ranges matched), not a per-paper quirk, so treat all papers as memory-reconstructions of unverified fidelity to the original exam. Two 2016-dated IBPS PO papers (30, 31) and the 2014 IT Specialist paper (18) order Quantitative Aptitude before Reasoning Ability, unlike the rest of the book.
